title: Recommend with reservations.
text: Recommend with reservations.. I bought this French Press for my camping trip. I thought it would be an easier method for making coffee, which it was. My main complain with French Press coffee brewers is that the coffee gets cold while it sits and brews. I thought that the thermal design would eliminate this problem.  I was wrong. It still cooled off unacceptably while brewing. The problem is that, even though the double walled design should hold in the heat, the opening in the spout allows the heat to escape through the top. I improvised a solution of my own by plugging up the spout with a wadded up paper towel while the coffee brewed. This was somewhat successful and allowed me to have hotter coffee than if I hadn't stopped it up. Plugging up the hole again, while I drank my coffee, kept the left over coffee warm enough to have a second cup, though it was cooler than the first. Without doing that, the coffee would be completely cold by the time I finished my first cup. If Planetary Designs wants to improve this design, I would recommend a completely closed system that allows the coffee to brew without any heat loss. The thermal, insulated design is really useless without that.
